hardware.reported_setup: User confirmed 24 V, MS1/MS2/MS3 unconnected (board pull-ups select 1/16), 3.3 V jumper bridged, common ground connected. Motor current limit not adjusted; VREF and cart motor rated phase current unknown. On 2026-09-16 user changed to 20T and reported comfortable 600 RPM and 20,000 RPM/s limits. On 2026-09-17 user switched back to 60T, retaining the same linear limits (0.8/12/12/60).

measured_pendulum.calibration_note: 20 same-side 5–20 degree decaying cycles across three pre-175 mm captures; user identified those as 125 mm / 11.05 g with the same two 5.85 g weights. Damping is descriptive.

safety_note: Without limit switches, rail position is inferred from commanded steps. A skipped step makes that estimate wrong. Validate manual motion and balance-only mode before automatic swing-up.

validation.candidate_note: v34 promotes the full-span v33 hardware preset: three 30-second holds; capture latency varied from 4.526 to 31.545 seconds. Compact-span candidates were not repeatable.
validation.checks: v34: boot and simulator defaults match the selected full-span hardware preset; 24 simulator groups, encoder command ceilings/reset, driver-disable, capture gate and startup-kick checks passed. Compiled for esp32:esp32:esp32; not uploaded.

rail_recovery.position_source: commanded steps; no homing or endstop sensor
rail_recovery.stop_prediction: Jerk-limited stop including acceleration ramp-out to zero

spin_recovery.speed_measurement: magnitude of filtered theta_dot; valid encoder required
spin_recovery.resume_cart_condition: within 3 mm of startup center, |v|<=0.005 m/s and |a|<=0.1 m/s^2
spin_recovery.scope: automatic swing-up, automatic balance and automatic rail recovery; upright-only bal retains separate fall-return-stop behavior
spin_recovery.runtime_changes: IDLE only; finite 0 < resume < trip; RAM settings revert to firmware defaults on restart

serial.reconnect: same port; valid STOP acknowledgment and three consecutive valid telemetry frames; never replay motion
serial.user_report: User reports USB/serial problems resolved after disconnecting ESP32 power feed from motor-power breakout; not independently measured.

encoder_calibration.mapping: uniform count scale relative to the saved live upright; no nonlinear correction
encoder_calibration.quality_note: 20 CRC-checked samples per pose. Upright/left rechecked against a reference; down had weak-field flag and AGC128. Left remains about 18.4 degrees from ideal. Only absolute upright updated; no validated nonlinear mapping.
encoder_calibration.upright_raw_role: 3953 is the fallback only. Query params for the active runtime or saved reference.

upright_only.fall_detection: absolute calibrated raw angle, wrapped about upright count 3953
upright_only.return: brake, center to within 3mm at <=0.1m/s and <=0.5m/s2 return acceleration, disable; explicit bal required to restart
upright_only.rail_protection: upright trial aborts and centers; hard rail or sensor/link fault disables immediately
upright_only.physical_trial: v18: seven upright attempts, all rail aborts; v19 direction flip prepared, not uploaded

historical_175mm_measured_pendulum.calibration_note: Refit 33 same-side decaying cycles with both peaks between 5 and 20 degrees from the three 175 mm / 14.2 g captures. Equivalent viscous damping is descriptive; pivot friction is not fully identified.

current_pendulum.simulation_damping_status: descriptive estimate from the 125 mm captures

prior_validation_v30.checks: v30: all eight user ceilings tested against actual command handler; driver disable, encoder reference/filter and spin recovery regressions passed; 24 simulator groups passed; ESP32 build passed. Hardware tuning awaits magnetic health. Uploaded and CRC-verified all eight pinned settings; IDLE and disabled GPIO27. Encoder remains at AGC 128; no subsequent motion trial.
prior_validation_v30.startup_response_fault: Stops automatic startup after 2 s and >30 mm cumulative commanded travel if pendulum excursion stays below 0.03 rad. This is not general stall detection.
prior_validation_v30.candidate_note: v30 pins user maxima: spin 150, bw 50, jerk 100, accelerations 25, all speed ceilings 1.5. Autonomous tuning pending encoder magnetic health and physical center verification.
prior_validation_v30.latest_physical_review: 2026-09-15 20:23 local: v4 trials reached 57.3 and 179.2 degrees from down, but no sustained balance; latter included a startup nonresponse fault. User runtime amax_s=5/jmax=50/ke=2.5 reached 105.3 degrees after another nonresponse fault. Repository settings held unchanged pending physical tracking confirmation.
prior_validation_v30.prior_revision_note: v17 upright-only validation reported an unrelated frequency GUI test failure; see analysis/upright_tuning.md.
